title: French Keto Crepes
description: Delicate French crepes filled with a nutritious and delicious pomegranate cream, perfect for a keto breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: Almond flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a fine-textured almond flour

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Room temperature eggs for better crepe texture

ingredients.name: Granulated sweetener
ingredients.notes: Choose a sugar substitute like Swerve or Erythritol

ingredients.name: Heavy cream
ingredients.notes: You can use full-fat coconut cream for a dairy-free alternative

ingredients.name: Pomegranate seeds
ingredients.notes: Fresh or dried pomegranate seeds work well

ingredients.name: Vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: Optional, use 1/2 teaspoon for a more subtle flavor

instructions: Separate the eggs and whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks, almond flour, and granulated sweetener until smooth.
Add the heavy cream and whisk until combined.
Gently fold the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with butter.
Pour a small amount of the crepe batter into the pan and tilt to coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for another minute and repeat with the remaining batter.
To make the pomegranate cream, blend the pomegranate seeds with the heavy cream until smooth.
Add the vanilla extract and mix well.
Fill the crepes with the pomegranate cream and roll them up.
